name: all
title: All
description: Meta-item that installs every component in this registry in a single command.

name: i18n
title: i18n
description: Internationalization store and type definitions.

name: page-header
title: Page Header
description: A page header with title, description, icon, and optional actions slot.

name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: URL-driven pagination with page numbers, navigation, and total count.

name: search-filter
title: Search Filter
description: A search input that syncs its value to URL search params.

name: select-filter
title: Select Filter
description: A select dropdown that syncs its value to URL search params.

name: button-group-filter
title: Button Group Filter
description: A button group that syncs the active value to URL search params.

name: date-range-filter
title: Date Range Filter
description: A date range picker with optional year navigation that syncs to URL params.

name: month-filter
title: Month Filter
description: A month/year selector with prev/next navigation that syncs to URL params.

name: metrics
title: Metrics
description: A responsive grid of metric cards with formatting helpers.

name: sheet
title: Sheets
description: Slide-over sheets for detail views and forms with sections.

name: navigation-tabs
title: Navigation Tabs
description: URL-driven tabs that navigate between routes.

name: json-tree
title: JSON Tree
description: A recursive, collapsible JSON viewer with syntax highlighting.

name: page-data-viewer
title: Page Data Viewer
description: A dialog that renders the current page data as a collapsible JSON tree. Useful as an admin/dev inspector.

name: search-command
title: Search Command
description: A Cmd/Ctrl+K command palette with debounced search, grouped results, and loading/empty states. Supply a search callback and an onSelect handler.

name: breadcrumbs
title: Breadcrumbs
description: Auto-generated breadcrumbs from the current URL with dynamic segment support.

name: time-input
title: Time Input
description: A masked time input (HH:MM) with auto-formatting and validation.

name: date-input
title: Date Input
description: A masked date input with locale-formatted display and a shadcn calendar popover. Binds an ISO (YYYY-MM-DD) value for direct API use.

name: card-form
title: Card Form
description: A Card wrapped in a form with a default Save footer — eliminates boilerplate on settings pages with multiple editable sections.

name: card
title: Card
description: Extends the shadcn Card with shadow-md by default. Drop-in replacement — same API, just change the import path.

name: registry-cn
title: Registry cn
description: Minimal cn() helper (clsx + tailwind-merge) at a fixed path for registry components.

name: color-picker-input
title: Color Picker Input
description: A hex color input with a native color-picker swatch and clear button. Binds a `#rrggbb` string or `''`.

name: scheduler
title: Scheduler
description: A generic cron job scheduler with graceful shutdown. Supply your own jobs at startup.
